stories.title: Williams-Sonoma CEO Laura Alber Sells $7.74M in Company Stock
stories.summary: Williams-Sonoma CEO Laura Alber sold $7.74 million of company stock, according to a regulatory filing. No reason for the sale was disclosed in the report.
stories.whyItMatters: Insider sales at a major home-goods retailer draw attention, though large sales by long-tenured CEOs often reflect personal diversification rather than a view on the stock.

stories.title: OpenAI Forecasts Cash Burn Near $280 Billion by 2030, FT Reports
stories.summary: OpenAI has forecast its cumulative cash burn could approach $280 billion by 2030, according to the Financial Times as relayed by Investing.com. The figure underscores the scale of spending the company expects on compute and infrastructure to build out its AI ambitions.
stories.whyItMatters: A burn rate of that size raises questions about how OpenAI plans to fund its growth and could shape how investors value AI infrastructure spending across the market.
whatToWatch: Any OpenAI response or clarification on the forecast
Further reporting on how the spending would be financed
questions: How does OpenAI plan to fund burn of this magnitude?

stories.title: Gold and Silver Hit Weekly Highs as Inflation Concerns Fade
